cross_case_boundary: Missing public consequences are missing evidence, not proof of impunity.
Formal findings do not automatically establish individual culpability or legal liability.
Institutional response costs cannot be promoted into worker repair or compensation.
Employment, police, bail, healthcare, detention, and custody remain separate causal and legal domains.
